zh-CN.title: 猫咪头像框会完整打招呼了
items: Niko 与 Fufu 头像框升级为完整 8 帧动画
猫咪会从头像框钻出、挥手，再自然退回消失
动画每 10 秒出现一次，不打扰聊天与浏览

en.title: Complete cat greetings for avatar frames
items: Niko and Fufu avatar frames now use complete eight-frame animations
Each cat peeks out, waves, and naturally retreats from the frame
The greeting plays once every 10 seconds without distracting from chat
